name: Hellbound Charge grants its mounted-speed buff inside Blackfathom Deeps (#5493)
contract: Hellbound Charge 807247 is a self-cast SPELL_AURA_DUMMY marker; xoroth_casts::OnSpellCast (AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp) reacts to it by applying 807248, which carries SPELL_AURA_MOUNTED (effect 0, MiscValue 914505) and SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_MOUNTED_SPEED (effect 1, +70%). Spell::CheckCast's SPELL_AURA_MOUNTED case (Spell.cpp) fails with SPELL_FAILED_NO_MOUNTS_ALLOWED whenever the caster's current map has instance_template.AllowMount = 0 and the spell carries no AreaGroupId; Blackfathom Deeps (map 48) is exactly such a map (data/sql/base/db_world/instance_template.sql: '(48,1,...,0)'), and 807248 has no AreaGroupId. Reaching 807248 through a normal CastSpell (as the previous 'Cast(player, player, 807248)' call did) therefore silently failed inside BFD: the player saw Hellbound Charge's own dummy marker go active but never actually mounted or sped up, matching the report. The fix applies 807248 directly via Unit::AddAura, which builds and applies the Aura without going through Spell::CheckCast, bypassing the no-mount gate the same way the adjacent id==801042 case in the same function already does for a different spell.

steps.label: SETUP: the knight knows Hellbound Charge
CONTRACT: Hellbound Charge's own dummy marker goes active (this already worked before the fix)
CONTRACT: the mounted-speed aura actually applies despite Blackfathom Deeps disallowing mounts
CONTRACT: run speed rises because the mounted-speed bonus is actually in effect
